why: Tests fix round 1 for lead tooling slice lint-dead-test-support, branch fabrikalfa/lint-dead-test-support, from fb0ccec. It fixes the review's two named faults in next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/unreachable.integration.test.ts and nothing else; node-kinds.json is unchanged and the open owner question (a .test-support.ts export used by nothing) is left alone. Fault 1: law 3 now plants, in every case, a helper for every spelling of every pattern in code-graph 0.15.0's two default groups (test-directory: test/, tests/, __tests__/, e2e/, e2e<suffix>/; test-helper-module: test-helper/, test-helpers/, test-util/, test-utils/, fixture/, fixtures/, test-helper.ts, test-db.ts, <base>.fixture.ts), each in .ts and .tsx, and checks that every default pattern and both extensions were met and that every planted path is a default place. Fault 2: the three laws move from fc.assert inside it.effect with a hand seed to @effect/vitest 4.1.3's it.effect.prop with Schema inputs (Segment, Folder, Name, Names, Several), runs from runsFor({fast: 3, full: 12}) and no seed (0579). Since no case may rest on what a seed draws, each case now plants every case its law must meet in one tree (law 1: a helper at next/'s top and a file of several in a nested folder; law 2: dead exports at next/'s top and nested; law 3: all spellings), and the coverage checks run per case. A fact found on the way: code-graph 0.15.0 counts a use by export name, so planted files sharing export names read as referenced-in-non-test-file and hid the file-name plant; every planted file now names its exports apart.
